# PDF.js distribution

Unmodified files from the npm `pdfjs-dist` package, version **6.5.438**, downloaded on 2026-11-09.

Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
Examples/API: https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/examples/
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/6.5.438

Bundled: `build/pdf.min.mjs`, `build/pdf.worker.min.mjs`, package metadata, and `standard_fonts/`. The build files are placed at this folder root; their contents are unchanged. Runtime assets are served locally so the quotation preview requires no CDN or native PDF plugin.

PDF.js: Apache License 2.0, see `LICENSE`.
Standard fonts include their original `LICENSE_FOXIT` and `LICENSE_LIBERATION` in `standard_fonts/`.
